name: Jive
overview: When the undisputed Latin ballroom champions leave the podium, the country's best dancers join the race for first place with a vengeance. But legendary coach Dmitry Smirnov makes an unexpected move: he breaks up the strongest pair in order to give an outsider a chance — a guy from a Kyrgyz village who is obsessed with the dream of dancing. This risky move turns the game around, forcing everyone to choose whether to fight to the end or retreat when the stakes become too high.
